scope: BGS V3 host-evidence recovery and native Question closure through an independent debug page
confirmedDefects: Successful native cleanup and drained host work had no durable evidence before settlement. A failed settlement or worker reload left an unrecoverable lease even though all local writes had ended.
Session-manager runtime cleanup rejection was logged and swallowed; waitForSessionIdle could then be mistaken for verified exit.
The standalone debug page could inspect events but could not answer a real pending native Question.
Reading all archived attempts failed on a missing transcript and hid a live pending question. Missing or unreadable history now remains explicit per attempt.

implementation.quiescence: Append host quiescedAt to the existing Attempt only after native cleanup and owned host work drain. Preserve actual accounting and question provenance, never grant passed checks from the receipt.
implementation.recovery: Authenticated version/attempt/fence CAS; reject active writers and absent evidence; mark interrupted task/edit failed, preserve pause, unrelated successes, bytes and request identity. No dispatch or paid retry.
implementation.questions: Read actual live pending requests; show unchanged questions/options/finding binding with empty answers; submit or deny through the existing project permissions route. HTTP resolved is interaction receipt, not authorization validation. Current-source guard and native validation/rejection events determine the actual outcome.
implementation.history: Cold reload reads persisted native decisions without reviving an expired request; historyUnavailable distinguishes missing/unreadable records from absence of decisions.
implementation.storage: Existing Run JSON and CAS API; no new tables, state machine, process registry, model loop or provider override.
